newsitem.title: USA: TCI Satellite takes ResNet stake.
newsitem.headline: TCI Satellite takes ResNet stake.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc subsidiary TCI Satellite Entertainment Inc said on Monday that it bought an equity interest in LodgeNet Entertainment Corp's residential subsidiary, ResNet Communications Inc.

The direct broadcast satellite unit said it would immediately buy 4.99 percent of ResNet's common stock for $5.4 million and it would advance ResNet $34.6 million over the next five years, to purchase Ku band satellite receiver equipment, in exchange for a note that would convert into a 36.99 percent equity interest in ResNet.
ResNet installs and operates private cable television systems in apartment complexes throughout the United States.
Under the agreement, ResNet would have long-term access to TCI Satellite's direct broadcast satellite signals in the United States, the companies said.

TCI Satellite would also have the option to increase its ownership in ResNet by another 13.01 percent exercisable after three years, in return for more cash investment based on ResNet's fair market value, the companies said.
LodgeNet President and Chief Executive Officer Tim Flynn said the agreement would reduce ResNet's capital costs and increase its programming options.
